title: Grounded Credit Assignment in Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Search Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.23148v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Outcome-reward reinforcement learning such as GRPO gives every token of a search-agent rollout the same advantage, although the rollout exercises two capabilities: finding evidence and using it. We show that accuracy improves without grounding: Search-R1 raises accuracy on all seven QA benchmarks, yet on Bamboogle the evidence-supported share of correct answers falls from 84.0% to 42.9%. We attribute this to GRPO's credit assignment: rollouts that retrieve answer-bearing evidence are favoured in aggregate only in proportion to their accuracy gain over the rest, a grounding gap that answering from memory or misusing evidence shrinks or reverses. translated_title: 多轮搜索智能体强化学习中的接地信用分配
translated_abstract: 结果导向奖励的强化学习（如GRPO）为搜索智能体轨迹中的每个标记赋予相同的优势，尽管该轨迹实际上运用了两种能力：查找证据和使用证据。我们证明准确性可以在缺乏证据支撑的情况下提升：Search-R1在全部七个问答基准上提高了准确性，但在Bamboogle上，有证据支撑的正确答案比例从84.0%降至42.9%。我们将此归因于GRPO的信用分配机制：检索到含答案证据的轨迹在总体上仅按其相对于其他轨迹的准确性增益比例获得优待，而凭记忆作答或滥用证据会缩小甚至逆转这种证据支撑差距。为解决这一问题，我们提出接地信用分配（GCA），利用可验证的子结果（证据检索与答案正确性）分别校正搜索信用与答案信用：错误答案所受的责备应多于找到证据的搜索过程，而绕过检索直接作答的正确答案……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出接地信用分配（GCA）方法，利用可验证的子结果（证据检索与答案正确性）分别校正搜索与答案的信用，解决GRPO等结果奖励强化学习在训练多轮搜索智能体时导致答案缺乏证据支撑的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Grounded Credit Assignment (GCA), which uses verifiable sub-outcomes (evidence retrieval and answer correctness) to correct search and answer credit separately, addressing the ungrounded answers produced by outcome-reward RL such as GRPO when training multi-turn search agents.
